freshReads.rule: Use a few familiar notes and a target, clap before making music, and give left-hand improvisation its own preparation before combining hands.
freshReads.limits: Teacher recommendations, not an intermanual transfer experiment; no copied score or author endorsement.

freshReads.section: Rhythmic values; Rests; Dots and ties
freshReads.rule: Flags halve duration, a quarter equals two eighths, rests denote silence.

limits: Project C3-E3/543, examples, one-pair choice, 48BPM, quiet bar and timing/self-check conditions are our design. Manual practice has no fixed-pattern grade, XP, physical fingering, creativity or teacher certification.
